title: Miko <> Kobi - 2026/06/16 09:30 EDT - Notes by Gemini
screen_reason: Internal 1:1 with WagerTech kickoff prep (discovery questions, PRD review), go-live target, phase outlook, build approach (AI framework, parallel object build, sandbox), process-design and data-model risks.

items.statement: Kobi will finish his discovery questions on the client's PRD and send them to the client by noon/midday on 2026-06-16.

items.feature_area: Other (business process design: lead/sign-up intake and rep data entry)
items.topic: Process design is the hardest part
items.statement: Kobi said the hardest part is not the Salesforce build but the process: how leads come in and how sales reps enter information, because the model is not traditional opportunities, contacts and accounts. Miko agreed that how users log data into Salesforce is the open question.
items.quote: But once like I think the hardest part about this project isn't going to be like the actual build in Salesforce. It's working out the process that's going to work for them. Like how are they going to get those leads in? How are they going to get like how are the sales reps going to enter the information because it's not like traditional opportunities and contacts and accounts that working with.
items.asr_note: Mid-line span of Kobi's line 266. Miko's supporting line 313: 'key point for how they log in like stuff like over to to Salesforce like will be like the the question mark'.
items.note: Jumpr-internal 1:1; the client was not present. This is the Jumpr team's internal view, not client-voiced evidence.
